# shunsuke-coda.github.io
印象評価アンケート作成ツールです。

<!doctype html>
<html lang="ja">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"/>
<title>印象評価アンケート</title>
<style>
  :root { --bg:#0b1020; --card:#121a33; --muted:#9fb0ff; --text:#e9eeff; --line:#2a3566; }
  body { margin:0; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Noto Sans JP", sans-serif;
         background: linear-gradient(180deg, #070a14, #0b1020); color:var(--text); }
  header { padding:18px 16px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); position:sticky; top:0; background:rgba(11,16,32,.9); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); }
  header h1 { margin:0; font-size:16px; font-weight:700; }
  header .sub { margin-top:6px; color: #b9c4ff; font-size:12px; }
  main { max-width:1100px; margin:0 auto; padding:16px; display:grid; gap:14px; }
  .card { background:rgba(18,26,51,.9); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:12px; padding:14px; }
  .surveyItem { border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:12px; padding:12px; background:rgba(11,16,32,.45); }
  .surveyItem .top { display:flex; gap:12px; align-items:flex-start; flex-wrap:wrap; }
  .surveyItem img { width:260px; max-width:100%; border-radius:10px; border:1px solid var(--line); background:#000; }
  .q { margin-top:10px; padding-top:10px; border-top:1px dashed #2a3566; }
  .qtitle { font-weight:700; font-size:13px; margin-bottom:6px; }
  .scale { display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
  .scale label { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:6px 8px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:10px; background:#0b1020; font-size:12px; color:#c9d2ff; }
  .pill { font-size:11px; padding:2px 8px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:999px; color:#c9d2ff; }
  .muted { color:#b9c4ff; font-size:12px; }
  textarea, select, input[type="range"] { width:100%; }
  textarea { background:#0b1020; color:var(--text); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:10px; padding:10px; min-height:70px; }
  select { background:#0b1020; color:var(--text); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:10px; padding:10px; }
  button { background:#2b4bff; color:white; border:none; border-radius:10px; padding:10px 12px; cursor:pointer; font-weight:700; }
  button.secondary { background:#1a244a; border:1px solid var(--line); }
  button:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:not-allowed; }
  .warn { color:#ffd1d1; font-size:12px; }
  .row { display:flex; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; }
  .hr { height:1px; background:var(--line); margin:10px 0; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header>
  <h1>印象評価アンケート</h1>
  <div class="sub">最後に「回答を送信」を押してください（内容は固定）。</div>
</header>

<main>
  <section class="card" id="statusCard" style="display:none;"></section>
  <section class="card">
    <div class="row">
      <div>
        <div class="muted">アンケート内容は固定です（回答者は編集できません）。</div>
        <div class="muted" id="sentInfo"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="row">
        <button id="sendBtn">回答を送信</button>
        <button id="resetBtn" class="secondary">回答をリセット</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="hr"></div>
    <div id="survey"></div>
    <div id="warn" class="warn" style="display:none; margin-top:10px;"></div>
  </section>
</main>

<script>
(() => {
  const SCHEMA = {"createdAt":"2026-02-12T04:36:54.426Z","title":"印象評価アンケート","surveyId":"survey_0212","gasEndpoint":"https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbxxHSq583QHxgNA0Li9IP8tNtzbMA81RSd0hya0dEQl0Ba0QG5enVJTLPaDrU48B3D6NQ/exec","params":[{"id":"i4997pat90hmliyuetu","name":"堅牢感","type":"likert","config":{"min":1,"max":5,"label":"1=そう思う、5=そう思わない"}},{"id":"v0z8qkicrkmliyuk2i","name":"統一感","type":"likert","config":{"min":1,"max":5,"label":"1=そう思う、5=そう思わない"}},{"id":"979isrl8cxamliyunms","name":"美しさ","type":"likert","config":{"min":1,"max":5,"label":"1=そう思う、5=そう思わない"}}],"images":[{"id":"czbrvzkk5d7mliytxm7","name":"Firefly_衣類用スチーマー、シルエットは台形、中央上部に拳大の穴が開いており取っ手になっている、取っ手の稜線には大き目の面取りがついている、色はマットな黒色、取っ手と同じ高さから電 413145.png","dataUrl":"data:image/png;base64,"},{"id":"0h5gu5zv4ugmmliytxn1","name":"Firefly_衣類用スチーマー、側面から見たシルエットは上すぼまりの台形で中央上部に取っ手がついている、取っ手の周りは面取りされている、色はマットな黒、取っ手と同じ高さのあたりから電源 185226.jpg","dataUrl":"data:image/jpeg;base64,"},{"id":"jjmeqe4rk2kmliytxo6","name":"Firefly_衣類用スチーマー、シルエットは台形、中央上部に拳大の穴が開いており取っ手になっている、取っ手の稜線には大き目の面取りがついている、色はマットな黒色、取っ手と同じ高さから電 413145 (1).png","dataUrl":"data:image/png;base64,"}]};
  const GAS_ENDPOINT = SCHEMA.gasEndpoint;
  const SURVEY_ID = SCHEMA.surveyId;

  const state = { answers: {}, imageOrder: [] };
  const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
  const uid = () => Math.random().toString(36).slice(2) + Date.now().toString(36);
  const SENT_KEY = "sent::" + SURVEY_ID;

  function shuffleInPlace(arr) {
    for (let i = arr.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
      [arr[i], arr[j]] = [arr[j], arr[i]];
    }
    return arr;
  }

  function ensureAnswerSlots() {
    SCHEMA.images.forEach(img => { if (!state.answers[img.id]) state.answers[img.id] = {}; });
  }

  function renderSurvey() {
    const survey = $("survey");
    survey.innerHTML = "";
    ensureAnswerSlots();

    if (state.imageOrder.length === 0) {
      state.imageOrder = SCHEMA.images.map(i => i.id);
      shuffleInPlace(state.imageOrder);
    }

    state.imageOrder.forEach((imgId, idx) => {
      const img = SCHEMA.images.find(i => i.id === imgId);
      if (!img) return;

      const item = document.createElement("div");
      item.className = "surveyItem";
      item.innerHTML = `
        <div class="top">
          <div>
            <img src="${img.dataUrl}" alt="">
            <div class="muted" style="margin-top:6px;">${idx+1}. ${escapeHtml(img.name)}</div>
          </div>
          <div style="flex:1 1 320px; min-width:280px;">
            <div class="muted">この画像を以下の項目で評価してください。</div>
            <div id="qs-${img.id}"></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
      survey.appendChild(item);

      const qs = item.querySelector("#qs-" + cssEscape(img.id));
      SCHEMA.params.forEach(p => {
        const q = document.createElement("div");
        q.className = "q";
        q.innerHTML = `<div class="qtitle">${escapeHtml(p.name)} <span class="pill">${escapeHtml(p.type)}</span></div>`;
        q.appendChild(renderQuestionControl(img.id, p));
        qs.appendChild(q);
      });
    });
  }

  function renderQuestionControl(imageId, p) {
    const wrap = document.createElement("div");
    const key = `${imageId}__${p.id}`;
    const current = (state.answers[imageId] || {})[p.id];

    if (p.type === "likert") {
      const {min, max, label} = p.config;
      if (label) {
        const lab = document.createElement("div");
        lab.className = "muted";
        lab.textContent = label;
        wrap.appendChild(lab);
      }
      const scale = document.createElement("div");
      scale.className = "scale";
      for (let v=min; v<=max; v++) {
        const id = "r_" + key + "_" + v;
        const l = document.createElement("label");
        l.innerHTML = `<input type="radio" name="r_${key}" id="${id}" value="${v}"> <span>${v}</span>`;
        const input = l.querySelector("input");
        if (String(current) === String(v)) input.checked = true;
        input.addEventListener("change", () => { state.answers[imageId][p.id] = Number(input.value); });
        scale.appendChild(l);
      }
      wrap.appendChild(scale);
      return wrap;
    }

    if (p.type === "range") {
      const {min, max, step} = p.config;
      const val = (current ?? min);
      const row = document.createElement("div");
      row.className = "row";
      row.innerHTML = `
        <input type="range" min="${min}" max="${max}" step="${step}" value="${val}" style="flex:1 1 260px;">
        <span class="pill" id="v_${key}">${val}</span>
      `;
      const range = row.querySelector('input[type="range"]');
      const out = row.querySelector("#v_" + cssEscape(key));
      range.addEventListener("input", () => { out.textContent = range.value; });
      range.addEventListener("change", () => { state.answers[imageId][p.id] = Number(range.value); });
      wrap.appendChild(row);
      return wrap;
    }

    if (p.type === "text") {
      const ta = document.createElement("textarea");
      ta.placeholder = p.config.placeholder || "";
      ta.value = current ?? "";
      ta.addEventListener("change", () => { state.answers[imageId][p.id] = ta.value; });
      wrap.appendChild(ta);
      return wrap;
    }

    if (p.type === "single") {
      const {choices} = p.config;
      const sel = document.createElement("select");
      const opt0 = document.createElement("option");
      opt0.value = ""; opt0.textContent = "選択してください";
      sel.appendChild(opt0);
      choices.forEach(c => {
        const o = document.createElement("option");
        o.value = c; o.textContent = c;
        sel.appendChild(o);
      });
      sel.value = current ?? "";
      sel.addEventListener("change", () => { state.answers[imageId][p.id] = sel.value; });
      wrap.appendChild(sel);
      return wrap;
    }

    if (p.type === "multi") {
      const {choices} = p.config;
      const curArr = Array.isArray(current) ? current : [];
      const box = document.createElement("div");
      box.className = "scale";
      choices.forEach(c => {
        const id = "c_" + key + "_" + uid();
        const l = document.createElement("label");
        l.innerHTML = `<input type="checkbox" id="${id}" value="${escapeHtml(c)}"> <span>${escapeHtml(c)}</span>`;
        const input = l.querySelector("input");
        input.checked = curArr.includes(c);
        input.addEventListener("change", () => {
          const set = new Set(Array.isArray(state.answers[imageId][p.id]) ? state.answers[imageId][p.id] : []);
          if (input.checked) set.add(c); else set.delete(c);
          state.answers[imageId][p.id] = Array.from(set);
        });
        box.appendChild(l);
      });
      wrap.appendChild(box);
      return wrap;
    }

    wrap.textContent = "未対応のタイプです";
    return wrap;
  }

  function buildPayload() {
    const responses = SCHEMA.images.map(img => {
      const a = state.answers[img.id] || {};
      const perParam = {};
      SCHEMA.params.forEach(p => { perParam[p.id] = (a[p.id] ?? null); });
      return { imageId: img.id, answers: perParam };
    });

    return {
      surveyId: SURVEY_ID,
      clientId: uid(),
      userAgent: navigator.userAgent,
      schema: { createdAt: SCHEMA.createdAt, params: SCHEMA.params, images: SCHEMA.images.map(i => ({id:i.id, name:i.name})) },
      responses
    };
  }

  async function send() {
    if (localStorage.getItem(SENT_KEY) === "1") {
      showStatus("このアンケートは送信済みです。");
      return;
    }

    $("warn").style.display = "none";
    $("sendBtn").disabled = true;

    try {
      const payload = buildPayload();
      const res = await fetch(GAS_ENDPOINT, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload)
      });
      const json = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      if (!json.ok) throw new Error(json.error || "送信に失敗しました");

      localStorage.setItem(SENT_KEY, "1");
      showStatus("送信が完了しました。ご協力ありがとうございました。");
      $("sendBtn").disabled = true;
      $("resetBtn").disabled = true;
      $("sentInfo").textContent = "送信済み（このブラウザでは再送できません）";
    } catch (e) {
      $("warn").style.display = "block";
      $("warn").textContent = "送信エラー: " + e.message;
      $("sendBtn").disabled = false;
    }
  }

  function resetAnswers() {
    if (!confirm("回答をリセットしますか？")) return;
    state.answers = {};
    renderSurvey();
  }

  function showStatus(msg) {
    const card = $("statusCard");
    card.style.display = "block";
    card.innerHTML = "<div class='muted'>" + escapeHtml(msg) + "</div>";
  }

  function escapeHtml(s) {
    return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, m => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[m]));
  }
  function cssEscape(s) { return String(s).replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, "\\$&"); }

  renderSurvey();

  if (localStorage.getItem(SENT_KEY) === "1") {
    $("sendBtn").disabled = true;
    $("resetBtn").disabled = true;
    $("sentInfo").textContent = "送信済み（このブラウザでは再送できません）";
  }

  $("sendBtn").addEventListener("click", send);
  $("resetBtn").addEventListener("click", resetAnswers);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
</body>
</html>
